args.sql: select type, count(*) from products group by 1;
select table_name, column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_name in ('items','orders','products')

with o as (select o.id, count(*) filter (where p.type='beverage') b, count(*) filter (where p.type='jaffle') j, count(*) filter (where p.type is null) u
from orders o join items i on i.order_id=o.id left join products p on p.sku=i.sku
where o.ordered_at>='2025-01-01' and o.ordered_at<'2026-01-01' group by 1)
select case when b>0 and j>0 then 'both' when b>0 then 'beverages only' when j>0 then 'jaffles only' else 'other' end mix, count(*) n, count(*)/sum(count(*)) over () share, sum(u) unk
from o group by 1 order by 1

args.sql:
with o as (select o.id, count(*) filter (where p.type='beverage') b, count(*) filter (where p.type='jaffle') j, count(*) filter (where p.type is null) u
from orders o join items i on i.order_id=o.id left join products p on p.sku=i.sku
where o.ordered_at>='2025-01-01' and o.ordered_at<'2026-01-01' group by 1)
select case when b>0 and j>0 then 'both' when b>0 then 'beverages only' when j>0 then 'jaffles only' else 'other' end mix, count(*) n, count(*)/sum(count(*)) over () as shr, sum(u) unk
from o group by 1 order by 1

args.message: Covers the 405,491 orders placed in 2025 that had at least one item. Each order is classified by the product types of its items. About 76% contained only beverages, 22% had both and under 2% contained only jaffles. Every 2025 item matched a beverage or jaffle product.
